# OpenResearchAssets · Agent navigation

> 中文权威说明：https://suchenl.github.io/OpenResearchAssets/for-agents/
> Machine-readable catalog: https://suchenl.github.io/OpenResearchAssets/catalog/index.json

OpenResearchAssets curates reusable research references, editable diagrams, workflows and research-quality guidance. It is Chinese-first with supporting English descriptions. Never assume a third-party figure or webpage screenshot is licensed for redistribution.

## Read first
- [AI 使用指南 / Agent guide](https://suchenl.github.io/OpenResearchAssets/for-agents/)
- [Canonical catalog (JSON)](https://suchenl.github.io/OpenResearchAssets/catalog/index.json)
- [Interactive discovery](https://suchenl.github.io/OpenResearchAssets/#references)
- [Asset schema & provenance](https://suchenl.github.io/OpenResearchAssets/docs/ASSET_SCHEMA.md)
- [Rights policy](https://suchenl.github.io/OpenResearchAssets/docs/ASSET_POLICY.md)

Suggested sequence: match task → stage/domain/kind → inspect applicability and rights → follow source or editable asset → verify final results.
